response.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '(blank)') AS hand, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_id) AS cnt FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY 1), shares AS (SELECT hand, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS excess FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess_over_mean_share FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: Each player_award row is matched to player by player_id with an inner join, so awards with no matching player are dropped. Each player's distinct player_id is counted once per throwing-hand group, across all award types and years.

NULL and whitespace-only values of player.throws are merged into a single '(blank)' group. Other values are used as stored, with no case normalization, so 'L' and 'l' would be separate groups if both occur.
